title.narrative: ''SANAD MENA Fund for Micro-, Small and Medium Enterprises (Phase III)''

description.narrative: The objectives of the SANAD fund are to create and maintain employment, especially for the youth, primarily through supporting MSMEs; to reduce poverty by facilitating self-employment, primarily through microfinance; and to build inclusive financial systems by cooperating with banks, microfinance institutions, leasing companies and other institutions to facilitate access to financial services.

The Semi Annual Reporting for SANAD Fund for MSME covering period up to December 2021 under Section 2 on page 2 states In detail DSF signed andor disbursed 13 new investments to financial institutions amounting to USD 999 million during the second half of 2021. comment.narrative: Target includes Baseline.

The Semi Annual Reporting for SANAD Fund for MSME covering period up to December 2021 under Section 2 on page 2 states In detail DSF signed andor disbursed 13 new investments to financial institutions amounting to USD 999 million during the second half of 2021. These new investments were related to an amount of USD 50.7 million disbursed to three Commercial Banks in Egypt Palestinian Territories and a PI operating across SSA six disbursed tranches in total amount of USD 27.7 million to five Microfinance Institutions in Jordan and Morocco three disbursed tranches in the total amount of USD 11.5 million to two Leasing Companies and one disbursement of USD 10.0 million to a Nonbanking financial Institution operating across SSA.However the Semi Annual Reporting for SANAD Fund provides combined results for all four phases and there is no distinction of the individual achievements.
